utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — before I share anything about the repair drive, can you confirm the date, the repair categories, and whether we’re collecting tools only or small parts too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday morning is the shift I’m filling now; categories are urgent home fixes first, then small appliances if we have hands. We’re collecting labeled tools and useful small parts too—can you send me what you have by tonight?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I’ll send you what I have by tonight, and I’ll label it as Saturday morning, urgent home fixes first, small appliances only if we have enough helpers, with tools and useful small parts collected.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I’m helping with Saturday morning setup and bringing tools for the repair drive—do you know where you’d like me to focus first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam—if you can start by dropping tools near the sorting table, I’ll be there at 10 and can help route them to the bike, lamp, and small appliance stations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll drop the tools by the sorting table first and keep them grouped so you can route them quickly when you arrive at 10.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, I’m still piecing together the repair drive plan: urgent home fixes are the priority, Tomas is set for Saturday morning, and Lila’s tools are still tentative.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Vik—but can you confirm whether Pia has verified the time, location, and what they’ll accept before I pass any of that along?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet, Kira—I haven’t heard Pia confirm the time, location, or accepted items, so I’ll hold off on spreading that part until I check.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, I’m trying to line up the repair drive for Saturday morning in the community room, mostly bikes, small appliances, and simple mending—do you know anyone from your crowd who’d want to help or bring something by?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can spread the word to the school parents—Saturday morning works better than pickup times, and I’ll point folks to the community center porch drop-off unless you want them bringing things straight to the community room.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Faye—hold off on saying porch drop-off just yet, because I’m still confirming the community room and exact hours. Once I’ve got that firm, I’ll send you the wording for the school parents.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, I’m keeping the repair drive location list updated—do you know where any kits, tools, or sign-up sheets should be marked right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal—please mark the main supply kit as still being gathered, with priority needs for spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, tape, zip ties, rags, and bike tools; Rosa is bringing the sign-up sheet and labels.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Cleo—I’ll mark the main supply kit as still being gathered with those priority needs, and I’ll note that Rosa has the sign-up sheet and labels until she confirms the placement.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Quinn—sorry, I’m a little behind on the repair drive details. Do we have Pia’s confirmed time and the actual repair list yet, or should I hold off saying anything?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got Saturday morning in the community room and we’re asking for screws, extension cords, work gloves, plus bike or small-appliance help, but I don’t have Pia’s confirmed time or final repair list yet. Go ahead with those basics and I’ll circle back fast once Pia confirms.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks—I’ll only mention Saturday morning in the community room and the basic supplies/help, and I’ll make it clear the exact time and final list are still pending Pia.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Leo—before I start telling folks, can you confirm Saturday morning in the community room and who’s taking the sign-in sheet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Saturday morning in the community room. I’ll handle the sign-in sheet unless I find someone to cover it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’s clear enough for me, Leo. I’ll start calling a few handy folks today and tell them Saturday morning in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Pia, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It’s 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re still asking folks for spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ve heard that, Tess, but I’m still checking with the building office before we treat the room, time, and accepted items as definite. Can you hold off spreading it until I confirm the drop-off and sign-in details?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you for catching that, Pia—I’ll hold off on repeating the specifics until you confirm the drop-off and sign-in details. I’ll just tell folks to save repairable things for now and wait for the official word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Uli, I’m a bit swamped and only skimmed the repair drive stuff—can you give me the quick version of what you can help with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course—Saturday morning we’re focusing on bikes, small appliances, and clothing mends, and I can help keep the table organized and match people with tools. If you’re swamped, even stopping by for a little while is plenty.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Uli—that’s exactly the quick version I needed. I’ll try to swing by Saturday morning and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rey—thanks again for quietly checking with the fixers and Lila; just send me whatever you confirm, and I’ll add it to today’s repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard urgent home fixes should come first, with Tomas set for Saturday morning and Lila still tentative on tools. Uli mentioned small spare things like tools, screws, old lamps, and steady hands, so I’ll pass along anything else I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that helps a lot. I’ll mark Tomas for Saturday morning, keep Lila’s tools as tentative, and prioritize the urgent home fixes while you keep checking.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I’m catching up on the repair drive—I’ve got a Saturday morning table shift and tools covered, and I’m asking around for a couple more fixers today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve heard—Saturday morning in the community room, with Gus bringing spare tools and Sam helping tables. I’ll pass along that you’re still looking for a couple more fixers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell—that’s perfect. I’ll keep nudging folks today and make sure my socket set and screwdrivers are there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Gus, quick update—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so if you’re still able to help, I’d most love you on setup and tool check-in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for the heads-up, Rosa—Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’ll handle setup and tool check-in with my drill set, clamps, and hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Gus—please come a little early Sunday so we can label your tools and set up a check-in table before folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so please spread that instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, Rosa—I’ll update the school parent chats that it’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday on the porch. Should I still mention Maple Court and the laundromat pickup points, plus the small appliances and bike repairs?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, please—keep Maple Court and the laundromat as pickup points, and do mention we’re especially looking for small appliances and bike repairs. Thank you for catching the date and location update, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, got it—I’ll tell my crew to bring broken lamps, chairs, small appliances, and bikes Saturday at 10 by the community room.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Bo—if anyone asks, tell them we’ll have folks sorting at drop-off, and I’ll jump in wherever there’s a gap.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do, Dane—I’ll add that folks will sort at drop-off, and I’ll send anyone with extra questions your way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing it together, Oren, but it sounds like urgent home fixes come first and folks can bring spare tools, screws, lamps, or just steady hands if they’re able.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That helps, Rey—thank you. I’ve got it noted as spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and steady hands now, with the repair drive Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds right, Oren—thank you. I’ll pass along Saturday 10 to 2 and those supplies so Mara and Cleo can keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Uli, I’ll bring my spare tools Saturday morning and label them; once Pia and I have the repair list sorted, I’ll pass you the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Gus—that takes a weight off. If you can mark anything unsafe or urgent on the list, I’ll quietly steer helpers there first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Uli—I’ll flag the unsafe and urgent ones clearly before I hand it over, so you can guide folks without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we announce anything, I’m checking with the office today about using the community room, and I’d like Mina to help me keep the repair list double-checked.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Pia—once the office confirms the room, let’s keep it to Saturday 10 to 2 and have Mina double-check the repair list before Tess spreads the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, but let’s hold Saturday 10 to 2 as tentative until the office confirms the room, and I’ll ask Mina to cross-check the list before Tess announces anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, the repair drive is Saturday 10–2 in the community room. Bring simple-fix items or spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and any bike/appliance know-how.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—I’ll mark the community room for Saturday 10–2 and note those supplies and skills; do you know where the sign-up sheet and any repair kits are being placed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sign-up sheet will be on the community room bulletin board by tomorrow morning. Repair kits are going on the back table near the outlets.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, thanks for that update — I’ve also heard Tess say they need spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and handy folks for bikes, lamps, toasters, and little fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Exactly, Nell—that matches what I’ve been spreading, and it’s this Saturday morning in the community room. If you can pass that list along to a couple neighbors, I’ll keep Tess and Cleo looped in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I’ll pass along Saturday morning in the community room, plus the spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and handy folks list to a couple neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Ira, I’m updating the repair drive list—right now we’re short on spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and people who can help with bikes or small appliances. Could you bring any of those or nudge a handy neighbor?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Cleo — I’m already bringing my socket set and screwdrivers and doing a Saturday morning table shift, so I can add an extension cord and ask around today for someone handy with bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Ira—thank you. I’ll mark you down for the extension cord and tools, and let me know if anyone you ask can take a bike or small-appliance slot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, I need the current repair list and Saturday coverage gaps—what’s still unassigned, and can you get me the urgent items by tonight?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll pull together the current list tonight: bikes, lamps, small appliances, and simple clothing mends, plus who’s covering what. The urgent gaps I know so far are Saturday sign-in, drop-off setup, and a couple more hands for appliances, but I’ll confirm and send it over by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—send it with owner names next to each item, not just categories. Who do you have for sign-in and drop-off setup right now?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana, I’m pulling together the repair drive list today—can you tell me any urgent broken items you know of and who owns them?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara — I don’t want to add anything unconfirmed yet. Can we first verify the repair categories and whether owners have agreed to be listed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Hana—let’s verify categories first and only list owners once they’ve agreed. I’ll mark unconfirmed items separately until we have consent.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—hi Tess, sorry, I’m still a little behind on the repair drive details. I think we’re waiting on Pia to confirm the time and place before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no worries, Noah—I’ve got the confirmed details now: it’s Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community room. If you’re spreading the word, we’re also collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, perfect—thanks, Tess. I’ll pass along Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and mention the screws, extension cords, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, can you take a Saturday shift or lend tools for the repair drive, and do you know of any urgent fixes that aren’t on Pia’s list yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can take a shift Saturday, Mina—though remind me if it’s still 10 to 2 in the community room. I’m bringing tape and spare batteries, and I don’t know of any urgent fixes beyond Pia’s list yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room—I'll put you down and mark the tape and batteries. If you hear of any urgent fix before then, send it to me with the owner’s name.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Hana — I’m still catching up through everyone else, but I heard the repair drive is Saturday morning at the community room, with folks collecting small broken appliances, tools, cords, gloves, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That matches what Quinn confirmed, Nell — Saturday morning at the community room, collecting broken small appliances, tools, and small parts like spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — that helps me feel less scrambled. I’ll pass along the same details if Vik or anyone else asks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m checking with the office today before we announce anything, especially the room, time, and accepted items. Could you be my second set of eyes on the repair list so we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, Pia—I can look it over, but send me the office-confirmed room, time, and accepted items first so I’m not checking against guesses.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely—that’s the safe way to do it. I’ll confirm those details with the office first, then send you the list to cross-check.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Dane, I’m keeping the repair drive location list current—do you know where any kits, tools, or sign-up sheets have been placed yet?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m set to be there at 10 to put up the sorting table, and Uli said folks may need pointing toward tools, screws, or lamps—but I don’t know their exact spots yet. I’ll send you the placements as soon as I see them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—I'll mark you for the sorting table at 10 and leave the tools, screws, and lamps spots as pending until you send the exact placements.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’m helping coordinate around school pickup—are you hearing Saturday late morning for the repair drive too, with the community center porch as the main drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s the first I’ve heard of the porch, Faye; Jules last said Saturday morning in the community room if it’s free. Once the room, exact hours, and sign-in plan are confirmed, I’ll start calling the handy folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’ll hold off on spreading the porch note as final and check back once the room, exact hours, and sign-in plan are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, we’re still keeping it tentative, but it’s looking like Saturday morning in the community room for bikes, small appliances, and simple mends—do you know anyone from your circle who could help repair or greet folks at sign-in?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Jules—I can ask Ira and Oren, and I’m already planning to help with setup, tools, or sign-in Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Sam—thank you. If you can ask Ira and Oren and hold yourself loosely for setup or sign-in until the room’s confirmed, that would really help keep the pieces connected.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m still a little fuzzy on the details—are we still thinking late morning this weekend, or should I wait for your final time before telling folks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s set: Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room. Go ahead and tell folks, and bring any simple-fix items or spare supplies if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room—I’ll pass that along and tell folks to bring simple fixes or spare supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, quick update—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so could you adjust the supply list and note that the basics are still the same?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the update, Rosa—I’ll switch the list to Sunday at the community center and keep the same basics noted: cords, tape, zip ties, rags, bike tools, sign-up sheet, and labels.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Cleo—that keeps us on track. I’ll make sure the sign-up sheet and labels are ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, have you heard about the repair drive? We’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the fixing happens Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, thanks Tess—I’m already pulling the list together today. I’ll add screws, extension cords, and work gloves to the collection needs and note Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Mara, thank you—if you can also nudge folks to bring bikes, lamps, toasters, and little fix-it jobs Saturday, that’ll save a lot from the trash.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, latest I’ve got is the repair drive is prioritizing urgent home fixes, with Tomas set for Saturday morning and Lila still tentative on tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik—that helps. Let’s keep Tomas on Saturday morning, and I’ll check once more with Lila about tools before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Uli—I’ll tell folks Tomas is still Saturday morning and that Lila’s tools are not confirmed yet until you check with her.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Ira, I’m still piecing things together, but it sounds like the repair drive is focused on urgent home fixes and small supplies people can spare. Do you know of any repair needs or tools I should pass along to Mara and Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t know of any specific repair needs yet, but I can pass along my spare socket set and screwdrivers, and I’m planning to take a Saturday morning table shift if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira, that helps a lot — I’ll pass along the socket set, screwdrivers, and your Saturday morning table shift to Mara and Cleo.
